notes.title: V1.1.3
notes.notes:
After reading several pieces of feedback I have taken the time to add the following:

- Added options menu when playing a story. (This can only be accessed during the actual story sections). This is accessed with the escape key. 

- Added volume slider

- Added full screen mode & windowed mode toggle

- Added FPS cap (Set to 60 by default)

- Added Vsync option (select this if you want higher than 60 fps as it will match your monitors refresh rate)

Thank you to everyone who has continued to provide solid, constructive feedback. I am listening, & I am reading. Thank you for your continued support.

**Localisation for menu options is incoming** English only at current build.

- Language updates

notes.title: Wishlist The Lullaby Weaver
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for checking out Chronicles from the Abyss. 

We originally started this as a side project to help fund development of The Lullaby Weaver, our biggest, most sophisticated project to date! The Lullaby Weaver contains open world navigation similar to World of Horror but on a grander scale. The Lullaby Weaver also contains dungeon crawler elements along with many side stories to experience. 

We have rotoscoped cutscenes & many options for different dialogue options for players to choose from, meaning every playthrough feels different. 

We hope you will consider supporting us by adding it to your wishlist. 

If you want to support us in the development of The Lullaby Weaver, we also have a Gofundme

Thanks for taking the time to read our announcement. 

Aaron & Adriano
